import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class p1096g_v4 {
    private static final long MOD = 998244353;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int[] digits = new int[k];
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            digits[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }
        
        int half = n / 2;
        long[] dp = new long[9 * half + 1];
        dp[0] = 1;
        
        for (int pos = 0; pos < half; pos++) {
            long[] newDp = new long[9 * half + 1];
            for (int sum = 0; sum <= 9 * half; sum++) {
                if (dp[sum] == 0) continue;
                for (int d : digits) {
                    if (sum + d <= 9 * half) {
                        newDp[sum + d] = (newDp[sum + d] + dp[sum]) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
            dp = newDp;
        }
        
        long total = 0;
        for (long count : dp) {
            total = (total + count * count) % MOD;
        }
        System.out.println(total);
    }
}
